From the 1900s through the 1960s, the club was one of the most dominant sides in northern Germany. Some notable honors from that period include the [[List of German football champions|German football championship]] in 1912, and being vice-champions 1910 and 1930. Holstein also won six regional titles and finished as runners-up another nine times. They remained a first-division side until the formation of the [[Bundesliga]] in 1963. They made their debut in the [[2024-25 Bundesliga|Bundesliga]] in the 2024–25 season after gaining promotion from the [[2023-24 2. Bundesliga|2. Bundesliga]] in 2024, but were relegated after one season.{{Cite web |date=10 May 2025 |title=Debutants Kiel back in 2.
